title: Safe cooperation in open-source game theory
question: Under what conditions can agents that inspect one another’s programs cooperate usefully while remaining safe for humans, including people outside their agreements?
summary: Five projects study coalition safety with externalities, certificates for joint behavior, finite reasoning and partial transparency, changing populations, and revisable commitments. Progress requires explicit adversary and enforcement assumptions, useful authorized activity, and proofs or reproducible experiments that distinguish protection from profitable cooperation.
